role: entry_audit independent narrow pre-code OS-handle design review, no implementation/runtime platform PASS
basis: Immutable WP042 sole FS ownership and unchanged manifest
decision: Windows OS named mutex plus Linux/Android/Darwin native advisory directory-handle locking is within accepted concrete OS-handle infrastructure scope. Conservative root-wide serialization is permitted; profile/catalog isolation and candidate paths are unchanged.
recommendedRootContract: Require a stable existing app-private absolute local filesystem root; missing root is named infrastructure failure. Avoid implicit creation inside Load/Recover or an arbitrary-thread constructor. Explicit provisioning later on worker outside read-only load/recover, by I composition, can be separately documented.
implementationConditions: All candidate observation/CAS/archives/preparation/pending/rotation/promotion/mainACK remain within one acquired OS handle.
Open root directory read-only without create; separate open FD per acquisition; no inherited/shared FD accidental unlock; all disposal and exception/cancellation paths close FD.

Nonblocking flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB with cancellation and monotonic30second timeout; capture errno immediately. EINTR retry; EWOULDBLOCK remains contention; every unsupported/other error fails closed with stable code.
Platform-specific ABI/constants and DllImport library linkage must be explicit (Linux/Androidlibc vs iOS__Internal); no silent MonoNamedMutex fallback on failednativebinding.
Stable private-root inode is required for lifetime; root replacement/removal is not allowed by application composition. Reparse/path checks remain.

Tests need distinct processes with second-acquisition exclusion, release/crashexit reacquisition, cancellation/timeout, same-process separate opens, and read-only directory/candidate no-delta. NativeLinuxUnity FFI evidence remains distinct from GCC/CPython supplement.

sources.claim: Native Linux advisory locks bind open file descriptions, distinct opens contend, closed last descriptor releases, read-only mode can lock. This is not a universal POSIX guarantee.
Official Android Bionic declares flock(int fd,int op) and errno failure contract.
Apple documents flock advisory API, LOCK_NB, errno including EINVAL/ENOTSUP. This does not establish actual APFS directory-FD support on target hardware.
Apple XNU sys_flock obtains vnode and dispatches VNOP_ADVLOCK with F_FLOCK; actual filesystem behavior is downstream. No actual iOS execution claimed.

limits: No code modified by reviewer. This permits precise scoped implementation, not interprocess/platform acceptance. Linux/Android/iOS native FFI/runtime and physical durability remain separately evidenced; unavailable directorylocking must stop safely rather than claim serialization.
